lines: 1. Ai nang kai khang suni, gaimei le banthai mei
Nang bumaeng lung khang kauh thu tei,
Ndap tarimei mak tingkao kandi khou tei,
[ Tingsaeng tak makpui ram gai khou]2 2
Tingsaeng takmak pui ramgai khou.
2. Tingkao gaimei ram tei, amang thang du khou man,
Neihla takdat makpui ram tei,
Duh mak khe tao heimu ram gaimei tei guang khang,
[ Akhang rui kai gaimei nai e]2 2
Akhang rui kai gaimei nai e.
3. Heikai tei akhang ra, naram e nang khang ni,
Na-za-reth jisu lung pui ram
Tingsaeng lung khang hei ram tei adi gaini cho?
[ Jisu rui liulou pui ram e]2 2
Jisu rui liulou pui ram e.
4. Hei ram khou kai tei ka,ramgai sa ngam makge,
Khou tei lung rianra mei makge,
Neihlamei le khuan gaimei lu rana suan na,
[ Kapum ma houlou ngam puni]2 2
Kapumma hou lou ngam puni.
5. Guang o apu chai thiw, lung neihlaa na guang o,
Tat dikho heiram gaimei thang
Zauzian loumei Pu aniu ta duang na lungni,
Rianra thaidat makpui ram khou
Rianra thai dat makpui ram khou
Lungh rian ra pingmei guai nailak khe hei khou tei, 2
[ Nailak khe mikdui kei datmei.]2
